recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, soft-focus portrait of a male vocalist with voluminous 80s-style dark hair, illuminated by cool blue and white studio lighting against a dark, atmospheric background. The composition features bold, slanted gold typography at the top and a stark white, condensed block-style nameplate in the bottom right corner.
coreVisualRelationships: Cool blue highlights on skin contrasting with deep black shadows
Warm gold italicized title balancing the cool-toned photography
Geometric, rigid bottom-right text anchoring the fluid, organic portrait
coreInvariants: Soft-focus skin texture with high-key highlights
Heavy drop shadows on the upper text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Close-up portrait, slightly off-center, occupying the central and lower-left two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the bright highlight on the cheekbone.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large gold title, moves down the subject's face, and terminates at the white nameplate in the bottom right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy dark space in the upper right and lower left corners to provide breathing room for text.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep navy and black for the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Bright white and pale blue for facial highlights and lower text.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted gold/ochre for the primary title text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation in the image with high value contrast; high saturation in the gold text.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to blue, black, white, and gold

letterConstructionRules: Upper text is italicized with rounded terminals and tight kerning
Lower text is ultra-condensed, uppercase, and geometric
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title text features a heavy black drop shadow to separate it from the dark background
Bottom text is underlined with a thick horizontal bar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, slanted script-like sans and rigid, vertical condensed sans.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and slant of the top display text.
Captures the ultra-condensed, blocky feel of the bottom nameplate.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a soft-focus portrait of a man with 80s voluminous hair, looking slightly down. Use high-contrast lighting with cool blue highlights on the face and deep black shadows. The background should be a dark, smoky blue-black vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add bold, gold-colored italic sans-serif text in the top left with a heavy black drop shadow. Add a white, ultra-condensed all-caps nameplate in the bottom right, separated by a horizontal white line.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting cool-toned and high-contrast?
Is the top text gold and slanted?
Is the bottom text white and condensed?
Is the overall mood reminiscent of 1980s pop-rock photography?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the gold text has a visible black drop shadow
Verify the bottom text is strictly condensed and uppercase
Confirm the blue tint is present in the highlights
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus 80s portrait + cool blue lighting + gold italic display text + white condensed block text.
